description: This file is a unit test class for the PasswordStrengthValidationAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test cases for creating and handling password strength validation API endpoints, including setup procedures and mock service registration. The class extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase and uses various utilities to run integration tests against the API.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthValidationAPITest
